title: plan review · Plan fails feasibility: 4 sources with controlled baselines under fixe
summary: Plan fails feasibility: 4 sources with controlled baselines under fixed token budgets likely unfindable. Pivot to descriptive metrics on specific benchmarks, explicitly noting lack of causal evidence.
body: The current plan requires finding 4 sources comparing dynamic vs. static memory under identical fixed token budgets. Historical data (research-1789651535062) confirms this is impossible; no literature provides such controlled A/B tests. The plan's fallback to 'descriptive performance' contradicts the strict 'fixed token budget' constraint, as descriptive studies rarely isolate token limits precisely. This creates a high risk of returning <4 sources or hallucinating comparisons. The plan must be revised to target a single, reproducible benchmark (e.g., BigBench) and accept descriptive metrics (success rate, token usage) without demanding impossible experimental controls.
